sandbox-city.title: Sandbox City: Zombie Survival & Free Exploration Game
sandbox-city.description: Sandbox City is an exciting zombie survival game where you can freely explore and drive around the city. Be cautious of the zombie's infection! Your mission is to find and eliminate the zombies before the infection spreads across Sandbox City. With its open-world gameplay and thrilling challenges, Sandbox City offers endless fun. Start your adventure now and save the city!
